Alpha Wang has given his Sell rating due to a combination of factors related to both the sector backdrop and Hysan’s company-specific outlook. He views Hong Kong retail property as structurally challenged, with tourists shifting toward experience-based spending and locals increasingly shopping in Shenzhen or online, which limits broad-based retail growth despite Hysan’s relative strength in high-end categories.
